accounting_scope: Published request rates; free monthly allowances apply to the account as a whole and are not deducted per benchmark. Storage, retrieval by storage class, notifications, taxes and negotiated prices are outside this request-fee projection.
multipart_assumption: UploadPart, UploadPartCopy and CompleteMultipartUpload are not named individually in the published A/B API list. Estimate them as A based on PUT/POST categorization, retain their counts and label this assumption.
error_assumption: Observed HTTP responses outside the published exemption list are included in the projection. Transport failures without a reliable response remain uncertain and outside the priced subtotal. The projection does not establish receipt or actual billing by Tigris.
